intro: Every service is productized, scoped, and runs on proven infrastructure, not promises. We build the architecture, you close the deals.

services.title: LinkedIn Outreach & Automation
services.tagline: Conversations happening in your LinkedIn inbox. Every week.
services.description: Multi-touch sequences that mimic human behaviour and generate replies from the right people. We manage everything from profile audit to reply handoff.

services.title: Cold Email Infrastructure
services.tagline: Cold email that actually lands in the inbox.
services.description: The full technical stack built and managed for you. Domain setup, warmup, deliverability, AI-personalised sequences. 98.5% inbox rate target.

services.title: ICP Mapping & Lead Scoring
services.tagline: Know exactly who is ready to buy. Before your competitors do.
services.description: We map your ideal customer profile against 40+ real-world intent signals. Trigger-based lists updated daily. You stop wasting reps on bad-fit prospects.

services.title: AI Lead Generation
services.tagline: Your pipeline shouldn't depend on how much time your team has.
services.description: Custom AI agents research, qualify, and prioritise leads at scale. 80% reduction in manual research time. 300–1500 scored, research-enriched leads per month.

services.title: Account-Based Marketing
services.tagline: Stop marketing to everyone. Go all-in on the accounts that matter.
services.description: Coordinated multi-channel campaigns across email and LinkedIn engage the entire buying committee at your highest-value target accounts, so your AE isn't the first name they've seen.

services.title: Personal Branding
services.tagline: Your buyers are on LinkedIn every day. Are they seeing you?
services.description: We ghostwrite content that positions you as the authority in your space. 4–8 posts/month from monthly voice interviews. Inbound finds you instead of you chasing it.

services.title: GTM Strategy
services.tagline: A go-to-market plan built to be run, not filed away.
services.description: ICP, positioning, and channel mix, built by the same team that executes it across cold email, LinkedIn, ABM, or personal branding. Reviewed and adjusted monthly against real data.

locationsText: From BKC, we run [B2B lead generation in Mumbai](/b2b-lead-generation-mumbai) and manage outbound campaigns for teams across India.
